questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Why high heels are back in fashion for men and women
Why comfortable shoes like trainers have become popular
The history of the Nike company and its famous logo
How to treat common foot problems at home
questions.why: Dan says the topic is the rise in popularity of the comfy shoe.

questions.q: Why was Neil wearing high heels?
options: He lost a bet with Dan the week before
His other shoes were broken and at the menders
He wanted to look fashionable and cool
A podiatrist told him to for his back
questions.why: He says, 'I wanted to look fashionable and cool!'

questions.q: What was Neil always told about trainers?
options: They weren't suitable for work or smart places
They were bad for your feet and your back
They were only for children and teenagers
They were too expensive for everyday use
questions.why: He was told trainers weren't appropriate for work and formal or social places.

questions.q: According to Victoria Moss, has the popularity of trainers happened suddenly?
options: Yes, it has all happened in the last year
Yes, after one famous fashion show in Paris
No, it started in the 1970s with jogging
No, it has been developing over about 10 years
questions.why: She says it's been 'coming on for a while', with casualisation over the last 10 years.

questions.q: What trend does Victoria Moss say has gradually spread into fashion?
options: Sportswear designed for older people
Casual streetwear worn by young city people
Formal office wear with a sporty look
Expensive designer shoes worn by celebrities
questions.why: She says there's been a big streetwear trend, which has filtered through.

questions.q: Why does Neil say fashion alone doesn't explain the trend?
options: Not everyone follows fashion
Trainers are too expensive
Fashion changes every year
Fashion editors don't wear trainers
questions.why: He says, 'Not everyone follows fashion, you know.'

questions.q: According to Emma Supple, what are people doing more these days?
options: Running marathons and long races
Going to parties and dancing
Walking more for their health
Buying more shoes online
questions.why: She says people are walking more and doing more for wellness.

questions.q: How have trainers changed to be more comfortable?
options: They have higher heels to improve posture
They are made of harder plastic that lasts longer
They are much bigger and heavier than before
They're made of fabric that fits around the foot
questions.why: She says there are lots of fabric trainers that wrap around knobbly bits.
